[SWS_CM_00201] Start of service discovery protocol on Server side
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00101, RS_SOMEIPSD_00024, RS_-
SOMEIPSD_00013
⌈
The registration of a new offered service which is bound to SOME/IP by invoking the
OfferService()
method (see [SWS_CM_00101]) of the
ServiceSkeleton
class
shall trigger the start of the initial wait phase of the SOME/IP service discovery protocol
after link up according to [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00133].
⌋
The different phases of SOME/IP Service Discovery on the Server side are configured
in the Manifest in the
SomeipSdServerServiceInstanceConfig
referenced in
ProvidedSomeipServiceInstance
element in the role
sdServerConfig
. The
configuration is described in more detail in TPS_ManifestSpecification by
• [TPS_MANI_03012] (Initial Wait Phase),
• [TPS_MANI_03013] (Repetition Phase),
• [TPS_MANI_03014] (Main Phase).
The corresponding timing parameters for these phases are configured via
InitialS-
dDelayConfig
in the role
initialOfferBehavior
,
RequestResponseDelay
in
the role
requestResponseDelay
, and
TimeValue
in attribute
offerCyclicDe-
lay
. The sharing of timers is described in [TPS_MANI_03230].
